coronary arteriosclerosis is more severe in ischemic heart disease than in arterial hypertension, but the difference is not significant.

in ischemic heart disease, the coronary arteries are more frequently stenosed than in hypertension, and that the stenotic lesions in ischemic pts. are located in the proximal part of the coronary artery, while in hypertensive pts. the stenoses are distributed more evenly.

the morphological characteristics of coronary artery stenting are similar in patients with ischemic heart disease and hypertension.
